title: Implement Q11-Q16 identity and lifecycle probes
objective: Add probes for durable execution identity, stale identity rejection, cancellation, drainage, active restart and drained restart, preserving per-start generation and terminal-state observations without adding launch authority to the production runner. Exception details committed as evidence must be bounded and must not include secret-bearing values.
test_seam: RED cases reuse a stopped identity, omit generation/tombstone state, or acknowledge drain before descendants terminate; GREEN requires distinct start identity and observed full drainage.
